(starting a new thread since the author seemed to miss my comment twice in a row)

Goal

* Please change "circle" to "cylindrical".

Input

Output

Thanks.

Hmm. How can you get 8 pieces with 3 cuts? (Test 3)
Can we make a cut along the vertical axis (3D) ?

Goal
* Please specify the shape of the cake.

Input
* Please change "Ligne" to "Line".

* Please delete "to cut".

Output
* Please change "Ligne" to "Line".

* Please add a space between "cuts" and "you".

* Please remove the double quotation marks (i.e. {{It's impossible}} is sufficient).

Constraints
* Please remove the second constraint, as it repeats a rule in the Goal section. That's not a constraint.

Cases
* I haven't verified all the cases, but how do you get 8 equal parts of a cake with 3 cuts?

* Also, why do you need 1 cut if you need 1 part of the cake (i.e. the whole cake)?

* Validator 4 violates the first constraint. Please change the input to 1 (this is an edge case, so the validator being identical to the test is fine).

Thanks.

Hello, 
I did all your modifications. If you see others, I'll be happy to correct them.

For the 8 parts with three cuts, it's a funny mathematical enigma:
2 * 2 * 2
You cut two times normaly to get 4 quarters. Then, you cut horizontaly do obtain 8 parts.

For the 8 parts with three cuts, it's a funny mathematical enigma:
2 * 2 * 2
You cut two times normaly to get 4 quarters. Then, you cut horizontaly you obtain 8 parts.

a picture to show you :
https://th.bing.com/...
yes we can cut along the vertical axis(3D)
In that case, what solution does your solver give for N=16? ;)

And then, why test 5 (7 parts required) is "impossible". We could just make 6 vertical cuts, right? :O
(Same for validator 5 -> 14 vertcal cuts)

You can also cut infinity times in all the possible wayn but the only way to be sure without mesure instruments, to have equals parts, is to cut the pieces in their half, and it's impossible for 7 and 14 because their arn't exponentials of two
Well, no, for N=16 your solver returns 4 ;) (But yes 5 is the correct answer) :)
Are the 8 parts equal? Do you have a diagram to show how the cuts are done?
